decisions.briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.2%, S&P 500 +0.2%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($289.29) is below the $500 deployment threshold, so per prior lessons we're holding rather than forcing a buy into a neutral tape — waiting for a genuine risk-on setup with multi-signal confirmation.

market_education.summary_en: Major indices traded essentially flat today, with the NASDAQ and S&P 500 both up just 0.2%, reflecting a lack of strong directional catalysts. Without a clear risk-on or risk-off signal, institutional flows appear muted and stock-specific momentum plays are driving most of the notable moves in the screened list rather than broad market sentiment. This kind of low-volatility, sideways session is typically a consolidation period rather than a trend change.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市走勢大致持平，納斯達克指數及標普500指數均僅微升0.2%，反映市場缺乏明顯的方向性催化因素。在沒有清晰的風險偏好或避險訊號下，機構資金流向似乎較為淡靜,個股層面的動能表現多於大市情緒主導今日焦點股份的波動。這種低波幅、橫行的交易日通常屬於整固階段，而非趨勢逆轉。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Sometimes the smartest move is no move at all. When cash reserves are too small to make a meaningful new investment and the market isn't showing strong buy signals, it's better to wait for a clearer opportunity than to force a trade just to feel productive.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 有時候最聰明的做法就是按兵不動。當現金儲備不足以進行有意義的新投資，而市場又未顯示強烈的買入訊號時，寧可耐心等待更明確的機會，也不應為求「有所作為」而勉強交易。
